tools.name: agentic.readiness_probe
tools.description: Free multi-surface storefront readiness snapshot (UCP/ACP discovery, product schema, robots, answer-engine maps). Not an attested Store Guard grade. Response includes a Store Guard $149 CTA. No API key required.

tools.name: dispatch.quote
tools.description: Return an instant dispatch quote for a field-service job. Accepts trade + location + urgency and returns matched contractor, estimated cost in cents, ETA tier, and valid_for_minutes. Requires a client integration key (x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer). Self-serve machine credential: POST /api/mcp/

tools.name: dispatch.estimate
tools.description: Keyless billed-cost estimate for a field-service job. Transforms a cited BLS OES hourly WAGE into a billed customer price: wage x labor burden x overhead/margin markup x urgency multiplier, plus a trip fee and a minimum-billable-hours floor. Returns wage_basis (the cited wage input) alongside billed

tools.name: dispatch.order
tools.description: Create a dispatch work order. Attempts to auto-match a contractor from the active pool. tools.name: dispatch.evals
tools.description: Return the public evals dashboard for a rolling window. Figures are estimated unless provenance.measured lists them. jobs_dispatched_30d and active_providers are null until a measured integer exists — not posture copy. No API key required.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dispatch.quote, dispatch.order · Private data: agentic.readiness_probe, dispatch.quote, dispatch.estimate, dispatch.order, dispatch.evals, dispatch.index · Public sink: dispatch.quote, dispatch.order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dispatch.quote, dispatch.order · Private data: agentic.readiness_probe, dispatch.quote, dispatch.estimate, dispatch.order, dispatch.evals, dispatch.index · Public sink: dispatch.quote, dispatch.order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
